nodes.name: Detect Explicit Route / Towpath / Public-Access Impact
Match Alerts to CDM Corridor / Ride Days

parameters.jsCode:
const config = $items('Set Connector Config')[0].json;
const records = $input.all().map((i) => i.json || {}).filter((i) => i.recordKind === 'officialGovernmentAlert');

const events = records
  .filter((n) => n.classificationLabel === 'ROUTE_RELEVANT_PUBLISHED')
  .map((n) => ({
    eventType: 'government_safety_alert',
    sourceType: 'prefectures',
    sourceId: n.sourceId,
    sourceName: n.departmentName,
    officialGovernmentStatus: n.officialGovernmentStatus,
    officialNoticeType: n.officialNoticeType,
    officialAlertCategory: n.officialAlertCategory,
    routeImpactStatus: n.routeImpactStatus,
    routeClosureConfirmed: n.routeClosureConfirmed,
    towpathClosureConfirmed: n.towpathClosureConfirmed,
    publicAccessClosureConfirmed: n.publicAccessClosureConfirmed,
    detourConfirmed: n.detourConfirmed,
    reviewState: n.reviewState,
    classificationLabel: n.classificationLabel,
    matchConfidence: n.mappingConfidence,
    title: n.title,
    summary: n.summary,
    rideDays: n.rideDays,
    departmentCode: n.departmentCode,
    checkedAt: n.checkedAt,
    sourceUrl: n.sourceUrl,
    externalId: n.externalId,
  }));
const reviewQueue = records
  .filter((n) => n.classificationLabel !== 'ROUTE_RELEVANT_PUBLISHED')
  .map((n) => ({
    eventType: 'government_safety_alert',
    sourceType: 'prefectures',
    sourceId: n.sourceId,
    sourceName: n.departmentName,
    officialGovernmentStatus: n.officialGovernmentStatus,
    officialNoticeType: n.officialNoticeType,
    officialAlertCategory: n.officialAlertCategory,
    routeImpactStatus: n.routeImpactStatus,
    routeClosureConfirmed: n.routeClosureConfirmed,
    towpathClosureConfirmed: n.towpathClosureConfirmed,
    publicAccessClosureConfirmed: n.publicAccessClosureConfirmed,
    detourConfirmed: n.detourConfirmed,
    reviewState: n.reviewState,
    classificationLabel: n.classificationLabel,
    matchConfidence: n.mappingConfidence,
    title: n.title,
    summary: n.summary,
    rideDays: n.rideDays,
    departmentCode: n.departmentCode,
    checkedAt: n.checkedAt,
    sourceUrl: n.sourceUrl,
    externalId: n.externalId,
  }));

return [{ json: { recordKind: 'compatibilityCandidates', eventsCompat: events, reviewQueueCompat: reviewQueue, generatedAt: config.generatedAt } }];
